articles.title: Ms. Rachel Is Making a Real Album — With a Cello!
articles.summary: Ms. Rachel, the YouTube star with the pink headband, is releasing her first album on Sept. 25. It has 23 songs, and she wants kids to hear real instruments like the cello. Her videos have over 17.2 billion views!

articles.title: Early Voting Starts! Americans Begin Choosing Congress for 2026
articles.summary: Early in-person voting began Friday in Virginia, with Idaho, Minnesota and South Dakota also opening absentee voting. The Nov. 3 midterm elections will decide who controls Congress — and voters say prices and the war in Iran are on their minds.

articles.title: Soccer Bosses Want FIFA to Share $2.1 Billion With 211 Countries
articles.summary: Two top soccer leaders want FIFA to give each of its 211 member countries at least $10 million — a total of about $2.1 billion. FIFA has about $6 billion saved up, and the leaders say it can afford to share.
